showCaption.description: Show the caption on this photo. Off hides the caption and keeps the text in the CMS.

credit.description: Photographer credit for this image, e.g. "Qwerqu Mcbrew / Unsplash". Type only the name, not the "Photo By:" prefix. Leave blank to fall back to the image's Caption in the Media Library, then to a photographer encoded in the filename.

showCredit.description: Show the "Photo By: …" credit on this photo.

fullBleed.description: Stretch the image to the full width of the screen.
